It encourages even pings allowing for the entire world to participate online in epic weekend bouts between the best players out there. This edition of sdCup is a one day, single elimination duel tournament meant to showcase the Frozen Five, an edited version of the Big Five perfect for the upcoming winter holidays, and of course to have some fun with a high octane action 1-day duel tournament! All players are required to be present in the #sdCup channel on the main [http://discord.quake.world QuakeWorld discord] 30 minutes prior to tournament start. That means, be available 18:30 CET or you might lose your tournament spot. ===Prize Pool=== $100 base prize pool, plus [https://streamlabs.com/suddendeathtv/tip donated] $900 for a total of $1,000 The only allowed rulesets are "qcon" and "smackdown". Make sure to do f_checks before the game starts. '''Game settings''' * This should not come as any surprise, but regular 1on1 settings apply. * 1on1 * DMM3 * No powerups '''Map picking''' There are no map repeats.
